title: COOM configuration
description: A configuration as an object per instance, starting with the instance of the product. Each feature that holds a value is a key. A single valued feature maps to its value, a multi valued one to an array indexed by slot with null for an empty slot. Roles are not part of the form.

value.description: An instance, an option by its name, a text, a truth value or a number. Numbers are strings where a JSON number would not keep the exact decimal.
